WITH member_lines AS (
  SELECT e.link_to_member, e.link_to_budget, COUNT(*) AS purchases
  FROM main.expense AS e
  WHERE e.cost > 50
  GROUP BY e.link_to_member, e.link_to_budget
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_lines, SUM(q.purchases) AS purchases,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, COUNT(b.budget_id) AS matched_lines,
       COUNT(b.remaining) AS known_balances,
       SUM(b.remaining <> ROUND(b.remaining, 2)) AS subcent_balances,
       SUM(ABS(b.remaining - (b.amount - b.spent)) > 0.000001) AS inconsistent_balances,
       MIN(b.remaining) AS minimum_balance, MAX(b.remaining) AS maximum_balance
FROM member_lines AS q
LEFT JOIN main.budget AS b ON b.budget_id = q.link_to_budget
LEFT JOIN main.member AS m ON m.member_id = q.link_to_member

WITH qualifying_lines AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.link_to_member, e.link_to_budget
    FROM main.expense AS e
    WHERE e.cost > 50
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(b.remaining), 2) AS total_remaining_dollars
FROM qualifying_lines AS q
JOIN main.member AS m ON m.member_id = q.link_to_member
JOIN main.budget AS b ON b.budget_id = q.link_to_budget
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_remaining_dollars DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC
